claim_boundary: A pinned third-party snapshot of public FencingTracker bout histories during calendar 2024, not an official USA Fencing feed or a complete census. Source names, clubs, birth years, raw IDs, event titles, Elo values, and win-probability fields are excluded from the normalized table. Non-tied score/result conflicts, tied reported scores, and weapon-unknown rows remain auditable but are excluded from outcome training. Event labels override inconsistent person-gender fields in single-gender events. Reporter-side orientation is not random and must be randomized inside each training fold. No repository or dataset reuse license was found, so row-level source and normalized data remain local and only aggregate audits may be published.
license: No repository or dataset license. FencingTracker describes its database as public, but does not publish a data-reuse grant; source rows and normalized rows remain local.
